capture_requests.procedure: After paired-probe detach, visit each visible subtab read-only, capture active tab and back path; retain values privately. Prefer naturally empty/disabled state; do not make transactions.
Same captured player, each tab then return; record exact route, enabled appearance, action menus without committing commands.
Capture competition/fixtures/table reachable tabs and Back; no time advancement for coverage alone.
One representative screen per navigation family, then enumerate actual visible tabs/modal states; preserve a useful empty state if present.
